name: EPI Labs Trust Registry
description: Public trust anchors for EPI Labs. Maps Ed25519 public keys to verified signer identities. Keys listed here are org-pinned; a valid seal from an unlisted key is NOT claim-ready.
note: Populate trusted_keys with {"<ed25519 public key hex>": "<signer display name>"} entries when production keys are pinned. Until then, browser verification correctly reports UNVERIFIED IDENTITY for valid-but-unpinned seals.
